channel.title: TukdaPay blog
channel.description: Plain-language guides on UPI: splitting payments, per-transaction rules, and how upi:// links work.

item.title: How to split a UPI payment above ₹2000
item.description: Step-by-step: break a bill over ₹2000 into UPI payments of ₹1999 or less and pay each one from GPay, PhonePe or Paytm.

item.title: The ₹2000 UPI threshold: what to check before you pay
item.description: Per-transaction UPI rules change often. How to find out what actually applies to your payment today, from the sources that decide it.

item.title: Does splitting a UPI payment actually save money?
item.description: A worked example of when paying a bill in parts saves a per-transaction charge, when it saves nothing, and what it costs in time.

item.title: How upi://pay deep links work
item.description: The upi://pay URL scheme explained for developers: parameters, encoding, what apps do with it, and what a web page can and cannot know.
